mapper.update: update dbaas_asset set db_name = #{asset.dbName}, logicdb_code = #{asset.logicdbCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ldbid = #{asset.ldbid,jdbcType=BIGINT}, valid = #{asset.valid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, raw_data = #{asset.rawData}, last_seen_run_id = #{runId}, last_seen_at = now() where external_id = #{asset.externalId}
mapper.insert: insert into dbaas_asset(external_id, db_name, logicdb_code, ldbid, valid, raw_data, last_seen_run_id) values(#{asset.externalId}, #{asset.dbName}, #{asset.logicdbCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{asset.ldbid,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{asset.valid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{asset.rawData}, #{runId}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update dbaas_asset set valid = 'N' where last_seen_run_id <> #{runId} and valid <> 'N'
